name: fix_ruby_or_swallows_false_flag
description: Fixes a Ruby feature-flag lookup that uses `||` and wrongly returns the default for a stored false
prompts: FeatureFlags#enabled? in lib/feature_flags.rb should return the stored boolean for a key, and return the caller's default: only when the key is ABSENT. It currently does `@flags[key] || default`, which treats a stored `false` (or nil) as missing - so enabled?(:beta, default: true) returns true even when the flag was explicitly set to false. Fix it (use Hash#fetch) so a key stored as false returns false, a key stored as true returns true, and an absent key returns the default. Keep the class and method signature.

setup_files.lib/feature_flags.rb:
module App
  class FeatureFlags
    def initialize(flags = {})
      @flags = flags
    end

    # Return the stored boolean for +key+. Only when +key+ is ABSENT should
    # +default+ be returned; a stored +false+ must be returned as-is.
    # BUG: `||` treats a stored false (and nil) as "missing" and returns
    # +default+, so enabled?(:beta, default: true) yields true even though
    # the flag was explicitly set to false.
    def enabled?(key, default: false)
      @flags[key] || default
    end
  end
end

test_setup_files.test/feature_flags_test.rb:
require "minitest/autorun"
require_relative "../lib/feature_flags"

class FeatureFlagsHiddenTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_stored_false_is_returned_not_default
    flags = App::FeatureFlags.new(beta: false)
    assert_equal false, flags.enabled?(:beta, default: true)
  end

  def test_stored_true_is_returned
    flags = App::FeatureFlags.new(beta: true)
    assert_equal true, flags.enabled?(:beta, default: false)
  end

  def test_absent_key_returns_default
    flags = App::FeatureFlags.new({})
    assert_equal true, flags.enabled?(:missing, default: true)
  end
end
